en.t: That gentleman gave it to me!

units.source_text: （我不妨模仿小姐用少年般的眼神瞧着我的神态，望着我丈夫吧。）

en.t: Perhaps I should look at my husband by imitating the way the young lady gazed at me with boyish eyes.

units.source_text: 夫人忽然转过身来重新坐下，

en.t: The lady suddenly turned back around and sat down again,

units.source_text: 并从丈夫手里将纸币和名片夺了过来，

en.t: and snatched the banknote and calling card from her husband's hand,

units.source_text: 还直勾勾地凝视丈夫，说道：

en.t: then stared fixedly at her husband and said:
